## `neuro.object.setPrototypeOf`

Static method on `Object`.

> Sets the prototype of a specified object o to object proto or null. Returns the object o.

## Signatures

```ts
setPrototypeOf(input: { o: any; proto: object; prompt?: string }): Promise<any>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.setPrototypeOf` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
